pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, amoeboid geometries with soft, diffused pixel-level edge gradients. Patches on the dorsal ridge are larger and darker, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented star-like shapes on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways forming a multi-nodal topological graph. Pathways show variable pixel thickness, generally wider on the neck and upper shoulder than on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck formed by a short, dense mane. The contour is consistent against the bokeh background.
